task.title: Viewing image tag information by using the API
task.shortdesc: To view image tag details for a repository in Red Hat Quay, you can use the API.

ul.li: You have pushed an image tag to a Red Hat Quay repository.
You have Created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: To obtain tag information, you must use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository} API endpoint and pass in the includeTags parameter. For example:

info.codeblock: {"namespace": "quayadmin", "name": "busybox", "kind": "image", "description": null, "is_public": false, "is_organization": false, "is_starred": false, "status_token": "d8f5e074-690a-46d7-83c8-8d4e3d3d0715", "trust_enabled": false, "tag_expiration_s": 1209600, "is_free_account": true, "state": "NORMAL", "tags": {"example": {"name": "example", "size": 2275314, "last_modified": "Tue, 14 May 2024 14:48:51 -0000", "manifest_digest": "sha256:57583a1b9c0a7509d3417387b4f43acf80d08cdcf5266ac87987be3f8f919d5d"}, "test": {"name": "test", "size": 2275314, "last_modified": "Tue, 14 May 2024 14:04:48 -0000", "manifest_digest": "sha256:57583a1b9c0a7509d3417387b4f43acf80d08cdcf5266ac87987be3f8f919d5d"}}, "can_write": true, "can_admin": true}

step.cmd: Alternatively, you can use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/ endpoint. For example:
